Veel MKB’ers zien bankmutaties niet dire: Many SMEs do not see bank transactions immediately reflected in the accounting: payments without a clear reference, card payments via a payment provider, or duplicate entries. Twinfield documents existing web services for bank ledgers, electronic bank statements, matching and ‘pay and collect’ (see official Twinfield-webservices). That means: the technical integrations for bank data and matching exist, but a specific mobile payment app integration is not automatically proven. Use this as a starting point: first collect signals, then review exceptions together with your accountant.
Ongeïnterpreteerde bankmutaties ouder da: Uninterpreted bank transactions older than 3 working days.
Betalingen met onvolledige of ontbrekend: Payments with incomplete or missing payment reference (no invoice number or only customer name).
Bankbedrag komt niet overeen met opensta: Bank amount does not match outstanding invoice amounts (discounts, partial payments, or currency differences).
Transacties van betaalproviders (iDEAL/S: Transactions from payment providers (iDEAL/Stripe/Adyen/Pay.nl) that do not yet appear in the accounting.
Vergelijking tussen de huidige situatie: Comparison between the current situation and the situation after resolving bank discrepancies: what changes for you?
Klanten betalen zonder factuurnummer of: Customers pay without an invoice number or use an internal reference that is not on the invoice.
Betaalproviders voegen hun eigen transac: Payment providers add their own transaction numbers; these do not automatically match your invoice numbers.
Bankafschriften zijn nog niet geïmportee: Bank statements have not yet been imported or were loaded in a different format, causing matching to fail.
Tijdsverschillen: retouren, intrekken va: Timing differences: returns, revocations of authorizations, or timing differences between receipt date and posting date.
Onjuiste cashflowprognose en risico op b: Incorrect cash flow forecast and risk of payment default.
Klantrelatieproblemen bij foutieve aanma: Customer relationship problems due to incorrect reminders or unjustified collection actions.
Extra werk en kosten voor jouw boekhoude: Extra work and costs for your accountant as errors accumulate.
Exporteer de meest recente bankmutaties: Export the most recent bank transactions (CSV/MT940) from your banking environment or payment provider.
Exporteer de openstaande debiteurenlijst: Export the list of outstanding receivables and invoice details from your accounting system (invoice number, amount, due date, customer).
Noteer welke betaalproviders je gebruikt: Note which payment providers you use and export their transaction overview if they run separately.
Controleer of het factuurnummer of klant: Check whether the invoice number or customer reference is included in the payment description.
Vergelijk datum en bedrag: komt het exac: Compare date and amount: does it match exactly, is it a partial payment, or is there a rounding difference?
Kijk naar “niet-herkenbare” omschrijving: Look at "unrecognizable" descriptions: search by customer name, IBAN, or the last 4 digits of the payment.
Stap 3 — Koppel waar mogelijk (middelen: Step 3 — Match where possible (methods and owner)
Laat je boekhouder of financieel verantw: Have your bookkeeper or financial responsible person perform the automatic matching in your accounting software; where possible use bank feed or matching rules.
Meetpunt: aantal niet-gematchte bankmuta: Metric: number of unmatched bank transactions after automatic matching.
Als een betaling niet matcht: controleer: If a payment doesn’t match: check whether it is a transfer between your own accounts, a settlement/offset, or an error.
Neem contact op met de klant bij onduide: Contact the customer when references are unclear: request proof of payment or a bank statement.
Controleer betaalproviderrapporten voor: Check payment provider reports for transaction numbers and processing dates.
Laat boekhouder uitzonderingen beoordele: Have the bookkeeper assess exceptions and record them as: partial payment, prepayment, credit note, or uncollectible.
Stap 5 — Sluit de lus (resultaat meten e: Step 5 — Close the loop (measure results and learn)
Resultaat: reduceer het aantal ongerecon: Result: reduce the number of unreconciled transactions to a configurable standard (e.g., at most X items older than 7 days).
Leerregel: welke type transacties herhal: Rule of thumb: which types of transactions repeat most? Adjust the payment instructions on your invoice (require invoice number in the description) or coordinate with your PSP.
Eigenaarschap: ondernemer beslist over a: Ownership: the business owner decides on changes to invoice and payment instructions; the bookkeeper implements changes and performs checks.
Doe zelf de eerste signalering en snelle: Perform the initial detection and quick checks yourself within 48–72 hours.
je na de primaire checks nog onduidelijk: you still have unclear transactions after the primary checks;
bedragen niet logisch te verklaren zijn: amounts cannot be plausibly explained (deviation > 1% or a fixed threshold you set);
er fiscale of juridische consequenties k: there may be fiscal or legal consequences (e.g., suspected fraud).
Beslissing: wijzig aanmanings- en betaal: Decision: change reminder and payment instructions on invoices.
Meetpunt: aandeel betalingen met correct: Measurement point: proportion of payments with the correct invoice number in the description (goal: increase to the desired % within 3 months).
Plaats op elke factuur een korte betaali: Place a short payment instruction on every invoice: "Always include the invoice number when paying."
Stel één verantwoordelijke interne check: Set up one responsible internal check: export bank transactions and outstanding invoices once a week and go through steps 2 and 3.
Vraag je PSP of bank om een export met t: Ask your PSP or bank for an export with transaction and reference numbers.
Bron en beperking van het bewijs: Source and limitation of the evidence
Twinfield documenteert bestaande webserv: Twinfield documents existing web services for bank ledgers, electronic bank statements, matching and pay & collect. This confirms that technical connections exist to import and match bank data, but says nothing about a ready-made mobile payment app integration; that must be agreed upon and tested per app and per project (Twinfield Web Services Overview).
Single change: maak één wijziging in je: Single change: make one change in your invoice layout: explicitly add the text "Always include invoice number (Invoice #)" directly above the payment details; after 8 weeks measure the share of payments with a correct invoice number in the description.
Noodzakelijke volgende stap voor onderne: Necessary next step for business owners
Als je wilt: doe een 30‑min check met je: If you want: do a 30-min check with your accountant this week. Export bank transactions + outstanding invoices and go through the five steps together. That way you will have clarity within one working day about which differences can be resolved immediately and which exceptions the accountant needs to assess.
